description: Calculate US sales tax (seller) or use tax (buyer) for an AI agent transaction. Returns tax amount, rate, jurisdiction, audit trail, confidence score, and advisories. Sellers get $0 sales tax in states without configured nexus (see configure_nexus); a $0 total means no collection obligation, not necessarily no tax, so read nexus_warning and advisories. work_type and transaction_type are sent as you give them and treated as declared facts (e.g. consulting is exempt in Arizona), so do not guess them. The response carries resolution.location / resolution.nexus / resolution.taxability, each with status resolved, partial or unknown plus a basis; total_tax is always returned, so if you want "unknown means do not charge", branch on resolution.*.status. Pass intent "estimate" to quote before a wallet signs: nothing is saved to history or nexus revenue, but it counts toward your monthly quota. Without intent (or with "record"), a keyed call is logged to your history, which is why this tool is annotated as writing even for estimates.

buyer_state.description: 2-letter US state code of the buyer (or DC)

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's 5-digit zip code for local rate lookup

counterparty_id.description: Identifier for the other party (letters, digits and _-.:@ only)

custom_software_attestation.description: Required with work_type custom_software; without a complete attestation the sale is answered as prewritten software / SaaS. Complete = written_for_buyer true, not_offered_to_others true, deliverable source_code or compiled_artifact (hosted is SaaS), is_modification_of_prewritten set, and separately_stated_charge true when it is a modification. The other fields are state-specific facts. Your representation, recorded with the transaction; not a state safe harbor

digital_content_type.description: With transaction_type digital_good: what the download is. Several states tax e-books, music and video but not digital art or printables

includes_prewritten_software_access.description: With transaction_type web_hosting: true when the plan gives the buyer vendor prewritten software beyond an incidental control panel or file manager (site builder, CMS or app platform, email or office suite, managed application). Absent or false = plain hosting of the buyer's own site or application

intent.description: "estimate" = quote before a wallet signs; nothing is saved to history or nexus revenue; counts toward your quota. "record" (the default with an API key) logs the calculation. Keyless demo calls are always estimates. Omit it if your AgentTax API does not accept intent yet

is_b2b.description: Business-to-business transaction (triggers state B2B rules, e.g. IA, MD)

it_support_scope.description: With transaction_type or work_type it_support: what the remote IT support engagement is. Absent = managed_bundle, the per-state default; some states answer specific scopes differently

maintenance_contract.description: With transaction_type software_maintenance: facts about a maintenance contract on prewritten software. Every field is optional; a missing fact is answered conservatively (updates assumed included). separately_itemized + itemized_amounts {updates, support} (summing to amount) split the charge where a state taxes the parts differently

payment_provider_type.description: With transaction_type payment_processing_fee: who provides the payment processing. Changes the answer in some states; absent = the conservative answer. Your representation, recorded with the transaction

seller_remitting.description: Buyer side: whether the seller is already collecting the tax

seller_state.description: Seller's 2-letter state code (needed for origin-sourced intrastate sales)

seller_zip.description: Seller's 5-digit zip. Required for TX/UT/AZ/TN origin-sourced intrastate sales and intrastate OH license/digital_good sales

use_context.description: Maryland only, with is_b2b=true: whether the purchase is solely for use in an enterprise computer system

work_type.description: What the agent's work is economically; drives per-state taxability (compute, research, information_service, content, consulting, trading, payment_processing, web_hosting, software_maintenance, it_support, custom_software). Pass it only when you know it: it is a declaration. consulting is an exempt professional service in Arizona. custom_software needs a complete custom_software_attestation, or it is answered as prewritten software / SaaS

name: calculate_tax
title: Calculate sales or use tax
